request: Monitor ML-relevant system resources in W&B

settings.x_stats_gpu_device_ids: unset: SDK monitors all visible GPUs

scope: Root pipeline and every enabled model run. Root persists across child models/inference/export; native process tree includes descendants. Native GPU stats use system monitoring, not a PyTorch CUDA context in the coordinator.
resources: per-GPU utilization, memory utilization, allocated VRAM bytes/percentage
GPU temperature, power, clocks when driver supports them
system RAM usage and available memory
root/output filesystem usage and disk I/O

verification.red_regression: Existing disabled setting failed the new resource assertion before the fix
verification.probe_workload: Nontraining child allocated128MiB while parent root remained active; native records decoded after finish

privacy: Only native machine/resource metrics; corpus-text logging stays disabled
limitations: Hardware-specific sensor fields depend on driver/container support
15second sampling does not guarantee capture of every short memory spike
Existing running sessions keep their loaded code; new runs receive the change
Offline mode retains local resource records; cloud live view requires WANDB_API_KEY and online mode
